# The errata of readings.emu: name, resolution, kind (`defect`: a defect of the text; `proposal`: a proposed
# normative change), where its readings are switched (`spec`: in the specification layer, at run time; `parser`:
# only in the engine's parser, the specification's grammar having the test262 reading; `none`: one reading only),
# where its literal reading stops a run (<sec-id>@<path>[<caller>], `none`: nowhere, `-`: not given), the
# spec-issue reports naming it; generated by `spec-gen errata`, and `spec-gen errata -check` fails on any
# difference. spec.html is tc39/ecma262 at b1eaed82f (external/ecma262).
# The file only shrinks: an added line needs the user's approval in the merge message.
